reason: A voice interaction plugin that adds browser voice input, Xiaomi MiMo audio transcription and speech synthesis tools, configurable voices, and playable audio output within DeepSeek Harness.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供浏览器语音输入、基于 Xiaomi MiMo 的语音转写与语音合成工具，以及可配置音色和音频播放功能。
summaries.en: Adds browser voice input, Xiaomi MiMo transcription and speech synthesis tools, configurable voices, and playable audio output to DeepSeek Harness.

capabilities: Captures voice input through the browser Web Speech API
Sends audio or text to Xiaomi MiMo services for transcription, semantic analysis, and speech synthesis
Reads and writes audio files within a configured audio directory
Provides browser playback and download of generated audio
